light_slot: Expand the original light42 slot in place. Odd rounds quality then no-quality, even rounds reversed. Both measure P0 only, with the D4.3-B Light capture and sealing procedure. Stock-clock observes only search/restarts/model clocks in separate serial runs after primary measurements. It supplies no stock wall, RSS or decisions.
compact_P0: Record once in the first Compact slot in each case/round; charge that full P0 including seal to both cycles. Both arms independently build P1 and run identical preparation.
order: Round outermost, frozen case order within round. Use all five archived rotations in order as needed. One immutable D production binary for both Light arms, Compact and same-encoding off. Native processes, worker, sealing and controller pinned to CPU 0; fresh process/work directory, natural caches.
confirmation: Test Compact-reuse versus genuine stock only; for each case and metric use paired median fractional saving >=0.05 and >=2 positive of the first 3. Any trigger including history extends the entire four-case cohort for rotations 4 and 5. Five-round confirmation requires median >=0.05 and >=4 positive. No passing claim from incomplete pairs.
recording: Use per-round 1 - (CompactP0 - offP0)/(LightP0 - offP0), reported separately versus quality and no-quality. A substantial case is one of circular-buffer, airline or snapshot, the previous three with >=0.70s Light extra versus 0.055s for fib. Count >=50% median and improvement in at least 2/3 of rounds. Show signed absolute differences for every round. For a denominator at or below max(clock resolution, observed range of same-build P0 off within the case), publish absolute costs; no fractional claim for an incomplete or noise-limited series.
cost_scope: P0 solve and sealed production payload, P1 full native process plus production control receipt setup. Exclude frozen repair and independent audits. Capture reported propositions, unwind obligations, witnesses, counts, root-work, RSS, phases, and first-use receipts. Full Audit/offline archive checks only after all timed processes have ended.
ablation: Only after confirmed P1 or full cycle net benefit >=5% with >=4/5 positives on a real repair, one B-only/B+M control using the same library, map, birth order and candidate pool. Historical gain alone never triggers ablation.
failure: Preserve every started run and its failure. Mark affected pairs incomplete, with no replacement samples. Preserve all signed mappings and candidate differences, including time-budget changes.
